prompt: I have a Word document containing a quarterly sales report with tracked changes from multiple reviewers. I need you to: 1) Accept all tracked changes from author 'ReviewerA' while keeping changes from other authors as pending 2) Add a new comment on the first paragraph saying 'Updated per management feedback' 3) Insert a new heading 'Executive Summary' at the very beginning of the document 4) Convert the document to PDF format. Save the final document as 'final_report.docx' and the PDF as 'final_report.pdf'.
